deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex through Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: Wirex addresses a key Cardano ecosystem gap: lack of integrated infrastructure for real-world payments at scale, everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity.

The proposal will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex has proven execution capability with 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal is expected to increase Cardano utility, transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity onchain.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The budget consists of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and a 115,385 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for Wirex payments infrastructure via Intersect, describes broad technical and adoption outcomes, provides a high-level budget and smart-contract custody process, and points to external voting, audit, contract, and dashboard references, but many execution, feasibility, risk, and alternatives details are not included in the anchor text.
